about: The sentences of the conflict choice question (docs/design/google-conflict-choice.md), one table for the server and the app: each row is the 409 fields of one change or delete and the body and lines both say for them. Read by server/tests/google-conflict-words.php (GoogleConflict::question, and the 409 message built from it) and web/tests/google-changed.mjs (googleChangedAsk). Timed values are said on the clock they are served on; the app test gives each the same wall clock on the device clock, so every row is checked in every zone. Invented events only.
